sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Cancer protects what matters. The core impulse is to sense, nurture, and secure—to build a home for hearts and projects to grow. At best: devoted, intuitive, tenacious. At worst: moody, overprotective, indirect. The craft is turning care into clear boundaries and choices.

Cancer themes center the 4th house (roots, home, inner life) across from the 10th house (public role, reputation). Track your Moon sign and aspects—e.g., Moon trine Venus (ease in giving/receiving), Moon opposition Saturn (care vs. duty), Moon square Mars (feelings need motion, not explosions).

Opposite sign: Capricorn—the axis from nest to legacy. New to the basics? Read astrology charts or generate your free birth chart.

✅ Strengths

  • Fierce loyalty; remembers what people need
  • Intuitive timing; reads rooms and tides
  • Tenacity—soft shell, steel underneath

⚠️ Friction Points

  • Indirect asks; simmering resentment
  • Clinging to the past; nostalgia as a cage
  • Overgiving without agreements

🧭 Growth Moves

  • State needs plainly, early
  • Schedule self-care as non-negotiable
  • Let actions—not guilt—hold the bond

sections.heading: How Cancer Energy Behaves
sections.html:
Daily Life

  • Builds cozy spaces; feeds as a love language
  • Remembers details—birthdays, allergies, backstories
  • Needs safe people to fully shine

Under Stress

  • Retreats into shell or goes sideways
  • Protective anger when bonds feel threatened
  • Reset: name the feeling, make the ask, take a walk

Somatic Tells

  • Stomach/chest tightness under criticism
  • Warm meals + breath ladders calm the tides
  • Water and rest restore intuition

sections.heading: Love & Sex
sections.html:
Dating a Cancer

  • Cook together, nest, share family/friend rituals
  • Consistency > grand gestures
  • Reassurance is fuel—say the quiet part kindly

Sex with Cancer

  • Sensual, slow, emotionally tuned
  • Consent is caring and explicit
  • Aftercare matters—talk, tea, touch

Attachment Triggers

  • Coldness, sarcasm, emotional disappearing
  • Unpredictable schedules with no check-ins
  • Trashed traditions; disrespect for family/friends

sections.heading: Work & Money
sections.html:
Natural Lanes

  • Hospitality, therapy, teaching, community ops
  • Home/real estate, food, brand care, HR/people
  • Any role where care is a core feature

Money Style

  • Saves for security, family, and home upgrades
  • Prefers steady income and clear buffers
  • Generous—set a giving line to avoid depletion

Team Edge

  • Builds trust fast; retains talent
  • Stabilizes chaos with routines and care
  • Holds memory—context that guides decisions

sections.heading: Growth Practices
sections.html:
Journal Prompts

  • What boundary would protect my care from burnout?
  • Which tradition still fits—and which needs an update?
  • How can I ask for reassurance without overexplaining?

Bodywork

  • Warm meals, walks by water, steady strength
  • Chest/diaphragm breath to soften armor
  • Screen curfew; sleep is sacred

Ritual

  • Sunday reset: cook, clean, calendar check
  • Weekly family/friends touchpoints
  • Monthly “memory box” review—keep what serves

sections.heading: Cancer Decans
sections.html:
Decan I (≈ Jun 21–Jul 1) — Venus

  • Home as art; affectionate and aesthetic
  • Guard against people-pleasing

Decan II (≈ Jul 2–Jul 12) — Mercury

  • Storyteller and archivist; family historian
  • Say the thing directly—no riddles

Decan III (≈ Jul 13–Jul 22) — Moon

  • Big tides, bigger heart; natural caretaker
  • Anchor in routines to avoid overwhelm
